title: Solo Max-Level Newbie
altTitles: I Am the Top Ranker Newbie
I'm a Newbie with Full Level Alone
俺だけレベルMAXなビギナー
ผู้เล่นหน้าใหม่เลเวลแมกซ์
description: Kang Jinhyeok is the only person who ever cleared the game Tower of Trials. After the game's popularity declines, he decides to quit being a gaming content creator. But on that very day, Tower of Trials suddenly becomes reality, and humanity is given only 90 days to clear its floors. Fortunately, Jinhyeok knows the game better than anyone. Using his experience, hidden knowledge, and skills from his years of playing, he sets out to conquer the Tower faster than anyone else and prove what a true max-level player can do.
author: Maslow / WAN.Z
